generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Converts meaningful signal combinations and gaps into discrete candidate ideas with a recognizable technical or user value proposition.

contract.purpose_user_function: Turn evidence-backed gaps, method changes, combinations, and cross-source relationships into discrete technical/user-value candidate ideas.
contract.valid_inputs: Idea-source records, evidence IDs, gaps, methods/claims, prior idea memory, and generation/selection limits.
contract.expected_outputs: Discrete IdeaCandidate records with title, hypothesis, approach, origin evidence, novelty hypothesis, and status.
contract.state_side_effects: Creates candidate artifacts and feeds novelty/feasibility screening.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Produces blocked/inconclusive or no candidate when evidence sources are missing, content is duplicate, or generation paths cannot form a meaningful idea.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Recognizable technical candidates are implemented; explicit user-value proposition fields are mostly embedded in text rather than separately typed.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test one candidate per meaningful signal, gap-based value, combination value, missing evidence, duplicate, empty source set, and candidate ID stability.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands (`/ideate`, `/novelty`); docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: skills/ideate/SKILL.md; skills/novelty/SKILL.md; harness/plugins/autosci/bin/autosci_bridge.py idea and novelty actions
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Final novelty promotion requires external evidence or Review LLM availability; offline/local overlap is only a surrogate. Strategic and portfolio criteria are not fully modeled. README.md#Platform Support states macOS is primary, Linux supported, and Windows/WSL2 experimental; live provider authentication, trust, network, quota, and approval boundaries still apply.
